meta.description: Estimates species trees under the multispecies coalescent from per-locus gene trees with ASTER astral/wastral/astral-pro (plus SVDQuartets, BPP, StarBEAST2), explains ILS, anomaly-zone inconsistency of concatenation, localPP vs bootstrap, and quartet symmetry for ILS vs introgression.
meta.executed: 7/7 inputs executed (ASTER Windows build: ASTRAL-IV/wASTRAL v1.25.4.8, ASTRAL-Pro3 v1.25.3.8; Java ASTRAL 5.7.8; IQ-TREE 2.4.0; DendroPy 5.0.13)
meta.execution_note: All data are SYNTHETIC: gene trees simulated under the multispecies coalescent with DendroPy inside known species trees and per-locus alignments simulated with IQ-TREE AliSim (data/make_data.py); every species tree was compared with truth by RF distance. ASTER Windows binaries, Java ASTRAL 5.7.8 and IQ-TREE 2.4.0 ran all Skill commands; the Skill's combined --gcf/--scfl command and the shipped examples/astral_pipeline.sh fail as written (exit 2). Not executed: Newick Utilities nw_ed (no Windows build; contraction done in Python), PAUP*/SVDQuartets (no Skill command, no labelled Windows build), BPP and StarBEAST2 (no Skill command, control file or XML). Thread counts capped at 4 (-T AUTO and astral -t 8 run with 4).

scientific_integrity.detail: Every number reported in the outputs came from runs on the SYNTHETIC datasets and is traceable to files under runs/; no DOIs, PMIDs or results were invented. The Skill's reference list was not individually verified by this audit.

practice_boundaries.detail: Pure research phylogenetics; nothing diagnoses, prescribes or triages an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: No methodological fallacy in any output. localPP was never read as bootstrap, failure to reject the polytomy null was reported as unresolved rather than as a resolution, discordance was not called introgression without a significant q2-vs-q3 asymmetry, and ASTRAL lengths were reported in their actual units. The Skill's anomaly-zone warning was reproduced (concatenation wrong at UFBoot 100 in the 2000-locus test); its units statement and ASTRAL-Pro command are correctness defects, not fallacies, and are recorded as P1.

code_usability.detail: Every ASTER, Java ASTRAL and IQ-TREE command the Skill gives ran on the installed versions except the combined '--gcf ... --scfl 100' call (IQ-TREE 2.4.0 exit 2 with a self-explanatory message), which runs once split into two calls as the Skill's introspect-and-adapt rule directs; the shipped example passes bash -n and runs to that same step. Recorded as P1 correctness defects, not unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 3: SVDQuartets, BPP and StarBEAST2 are named with no command, control file or XML; the ASTRAL-Pro command omits the gene-to-species mapping. Correctness 2: the combined '--gcf ... --scfl 100' command is rejected by IQ-TREE 2.4.0; 'branch lengths are in coalescent units' is false for the ASTER astral/astral-pro it targets (default --length SULength); 'cf.cf.stat has per-branch q1/q2/q3' is false; 'conda install -c bioconda bpp' names a package bioconda does not have. Theory (1-(2/3)e^-tau table, anomaly zone, quartet-level consistency) reproduced by simulation. Appropriateness 4.

reliability.note: Common Errors table with cause/solution and an introspect-and-adapt rule; but the shipped example's nw_ed fallback silently skips contraction and set -e aborts it at the CF step after the expensive gene-tree stage, leaving no CF output.

performance_context.note: 209-line SKILL.md with dense tables and no redundant steps; everything loads at once but it is compact.

agent_usability.note: Strong error prevention (Java vs ASTER -t, localPP is not bootstrap, units caveat, paralogy); consistency 3 because the stated units contradict ASTER's default output and wastral/astral write different units.

human_usability.note: Usage guide has natural prompts; the description is a single ~900-character jargon block.

security.note: Local tools only, no credentials or network; no input sanity check such as taxon-name consistency across gene trees.

maintainability.note: Clear sections and one example script; the example is declared not spot-runnable, ships no test data or expected output, and fails as written on IQ-TREE 2.4.0.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger with explicit routing; StarBEAST2 is routed to bayesian-inference, which has no StarBEAST2 content and routes coalescent species trees back here; seeds present.

key_strengths: Correct, verified coalescent theory: the 1-(2/3)e^-tau discordance table and quartet-level consistency in the anomaly zone reproduced by simulation
ASTER vs Java ASTRAL flag mapping (-t threads vs annotation, -u 2, --root) is accurate against both binaries

The q2-vs-q3 symmetry reading correctly isolated the one simulated introgression branch

recommendations.title: Split the --gcf/--scfl concordance command into two calls
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md and examples/astral_pipeline.sh combine --gcf with --scfl; IQ-TREE 2.4.0 exits 2 ('Do not specify --scf or --gcf with --scfl') on every dataset, and the shipped example aborts there after its gene-tree stage.
recommendations.root_cause: The command was not run against a current IQ-TREE 2 build.
recommendations.fix: Use 'iqtree2 -t species.tre --gcf gene_trees.nwk --prefix cf_g' and 'iqtree2 -te species.tre -s concat.fasta --scfl 100 --prefix cf_s' in both files.

recommendations.title: Correct the ASTER branch-length units statement
recommendations.problem: The Skill says ASTRAL lengths are coalescent units with undefined tips; ASTER astral/astral-pro (ASTRAL-IV/Pro3) default to --length SULength and write tip lengths, so users would convert substitution lengths as if they were coalescent units.
recommendations.root_cause: The units text describes Java ASTRAL 5.x, not the ASTER binaries the Skill targets.
recommendations.fix: State that ASTER astral defaults to substitution units; use '--length CULength' or read CULength from '-u 2' labels; note wastral writes coalescent units.

recommendations.title: Add the gene-to-species mapping to the ASTRAL-Pro command
recommendations.problem: 'astral-pro -i family_trees.nwk -o species_pro.tre' on families named Sp_A_1/Sp_A_2 exits 0 with no warning and returns a 16-tip tree of gene copies, not a species tree.
recommendations.root_cause: The command omits -a and the Skill never says multi-copy gene names must be mapped to species.
recommendations.fix: Write 'astral-pro -a gene2species.txt -i family_trees.nwk -o species_pro.tre', describe the two-column map format, and warn that without it each copy becomes a species.

recommendations.title: Make gene-tree contraction work with UFBoot and on Windows
recommendations.problem: The <10% contraction collapses 0-2 branches on IQ-TREE -B 1000 gene trees because UFBoot is rarely below 10, and nw_ed has no Windows build.
recommendations.root_cause: The threshold is taken from standard-bootstrap practice while the upstream command produces UFBoot.
recommendations.fix: Say the 10% rule applies to standard bootstrap (or give a UFBoot-appropriate cut-off), prefer wASTRAL, and give a portable contraction snippet (e.g. DendroPy/ete3).

recommendations.title: Give a concrete q2/q3 asymmetry test
recommendations.problem: The Skill says to confirm asymmetry but gives no test, does not say which topology q2/q3 denote, and wrongly says cf.cf.stat has q1/q2/q3.
recommendations.root_cause: Interpretation guidance was written without a worked output.
recommendations.fix: Document 'astral -u 3' (freqQuad.csv) to name each minority topology, add a binomial or chi-square f2-vs-f3 test, and describe cf.stat's gDF1/gDF2 columns instead.

recommendations.title: Fix install lines; add SVDQuartets/BPP/StarBEAST2 commands
recommendations.problem: 'conda install -c bioconda bpp' names a non-existent package, bioconda iqtree now installs iqtree3 not iqtree2, and the three named alternative methods have no command, control file or XML.
recommendations.root_cause: Prerequisites and method table were not checked against current package channels.
recommendations.fix: Point to the BPP GitHub releases, note the iqtree3 binary name, and add a minimal PAUP* SVDQuartets block and a BPP control-file skeleton or route explicitly.

recommendations.title: Resolve circular StarBEAST2 routing and flag-mixup wording
recommendations.problem: StarBEAST2 is routed to bayesian-inference, which routes species trees back here; the Skill says Java '-t 8' in ASTER yields no annotation, but ASTER still writes localPP.
recommendations.root_cause: Cross-Skill routing and the flag note were not checked against sibling Skills and binary output.
recommendations.fix: Keep StarBEAST2 guidance in this Skill or add it to bayesian-inference; reword to 'yields default localPP only, no q1/q2/q3'.

recommendations.title: Qualify quartet-method recovery deep in the anomaly zone
recommendations.problem: In a 0.01-CU anomaly zone with 2000 error-free gene trees ASTRAL also returned the anomalous split (localPP 0.75, polytomy p 0.23), while the Skill implies quartet methods simply recover the species tree there.
recommendations.root_cause: Asymptotic consistency is presented without its finite-sample cost when quartet frequencies differ by about 1 percent.
recommendations.fix: State that consistency can need very many loci in deep anomaly zones and that the deliverable there is a supported near-polytomy (low localPP, failed polytomy test), not a resolved coalescent topology.
